name: Waste Falcon
summary: Roll-off dumpsters with prices on the booking pages. Those prices are for rentals within 25 miles of College Station. A travel fee applies farther out, and the amount is not published. Loading help is referred to BCS Junk Removal. No Waste Falcon junk removal price list was published.
accepted: The homepage FAQ lists most construction debris, household junk, furniture, appliances, roofing materials, drywall, and yard waste.
prohibited: The homepage FAQ says hazardous materials such as paint, chemicals, batteries, and tires are not allowed. The pricing page lists tires at $10 each and Freon units at $25 each. Those two pages disagree.
gaps: Days, tons, and per-ton fee on the 10-yard, 15-yard, and 15-yard swap booking pages
Travel fee amount outside 25 miles of College Station

The 20- and 30-yard booking pages say $42 per ton and $8 a day after day 10. This row keeps only what this booking page states. Price shown is for rentals within 25 miles of College Station.
